names.note: Name page 14515 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Ардалион (Пономарев), архимандрит, прмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Ардалиона». `fk.mjs` returns NONE: the corpus keeps `ardalion-the-mime`, the martyr of the Julian 14 April whose own form is the bare «Ардалион», and the surname is what keeps the two apart.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 июля ст. ст. — «Прмч. Ардалиона (1938).»

attestations.note: The day's ninth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page behind it. «архимандрит» is the `office` Archimandrite, which all four locale packs carry, and `monk` is in `types` because `archimandrite` is not in this corpus's `types` vocabulary. «Прмч.» is the `venerable-martyr`. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. NOT TO BE CONFUSED WITH `ardalion-the-mime`, the actor martyred under Maximian Galerius and kept by this same calendar on 14 апреля. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
